title: Equil pump reservoir change failure on v3.4.2.1 - Piston rod does not extend
body: I updated to AndroidAPS v3.4.2.1 on Thursday. Today was our first reservoir change on the Equil pump since the update. I tried the process three times and even restarted the AAPS app, but the pump was unwilling to extend the piston rod. After reverting to v3.4.0.0, everything works correctly again.
